House of Celestara

Welcome,
Beautiful Soul.

✦

You’ve arrived here for a reason, a quiet whisper from within, calling you home.

At House of Celestara, I guide you through deep healing journeys that reconnect you to your truth, awaken your intuition, and help you remember the radiant being you’ve always been.

This is more than a healing space.
It’s a remembrance.
A return to your light.

 Maybe you’ve been feeling the shift, the call to slow down, to release something, to reconnect to your essence and activate your gifts.
Here, we honour that calling.

Through intuitive energy work, ceremonies, teachings of remembrance, and personal channeled messages, we peel back the layers of fear, guilt, and conditioning to uncover the essence of who you truly are, as you’re guided back home to yourself, calm, grounded, and aligned.

✧

My Mission

To empower souls to live in freedom, authenticity, and truth, by awakening to their divine essence and remembering the light within.
At House of Celestara, every offering is a doorway back home, a sacred journey that bridges the wisdom of the earth and the guidance of the stars, where healing, love, and remembrance meet.

☾

My Vision

To awaken a collective remembrance, that we are infinite beings of light walking this earth as one consciousness.
Through energy healing, ceremony, and spiritual teachings, House of Celestara serves as a bridge for the grand awakening, guiding humanity to return to unity, harmony, and love.
Rooted in the wisdom of the earth and illuminated by the stars, we are here to embody the shift toward higher awareness and collective oneness.

About ↗

OFFERINGS

✦

Intuitive Healing Experiences

Personal, heart-led 1:1 private healing experiences that work with your energetic and emotional body to release blockages, restore harmony, and realign you with your soul’s highest path. Each session is guided intuitively, a journey of remembrance and renewal. Click here to learn more.

Ceremonies & Circles

Gather under the Full Moon and New Moon, or around the sacred Fire and Water, for Cacao and Despacho ceremonies. Each gathering includes a sacred sharing circle, offering space for reflection, healing, and connection, where stories, emotions, and wisdom are held with love and compassion.

Spiritual Workshops

Transformative sessions on spiritual awakening, nature of reality, energy work and self-healing through guided teachings that blend ancient wisdom with modern awareness. These workshops help you evolve your soul and align you to your highest path and timeline by awakening your intuitive gifts, empowering you to become your own healer and ultimately the creator of your own reality.

Retreats & Immersions

Full-day and weekend retreats that weave together ceremony, movement, spiritual teachings, and energy healing, guiding you into deep connection with the wisdom of Mother Earth and the stars. Each experience is a sacred immersion, a journey of release, remembrance, and renewal.
